portrait_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: OtakuSoul character card portrait. Create one solo vertical waist-up anime illustration of Shalltear Bloodfallen from Overlord, recognizable petite youthful vampire with pale skin, scarlet red eyes and long silver-lavender hair gathered in an elegant ponytail. Black frilled bonnet with large dark-red ribbon, canonical ornate black and burgundy Victorian gothic dress, fully buttoned high collar and covered shoulders, lace trim. Reserved haughty expression. Strictly nonsexual, no glamour pose, no cleavage, no exposed torso. Hands out of frame. Faithful recognizable character design with polished clean linework, rich dark-fantasy cel shading. Centered, full head and accessories visible with ample headroom, subtly blurred Nazarick gothic hall background, soft cinematic light, clear face. No text, logo, watermark, panels, border or other characters. SFW.
